Attending Medical Officer: Dr. Farooq Ahmad, Senior Medical Officer (General Medicine)
Consultation Type: Gastrointestinal & Stress Clinic
Diagnosis: Stress-Induced Gastritis & Tension Cephalea with High Workload Strain
Clinical Notes & Observations:
